provenance.operatorDescription: Replaces the sharedTime the orchestrator passes in.
provenance.operatorRationale: sharedTime is the sole source of registerDate (SetInformantRegister/index.js:83 -> DateService.getLocalDateTime) and therefore of fileName (OutboundInformantRegister/index.js:48 -> DateService.getLocalDate). Both go through moment-timezone pinned to Europe/London, so the BST/GMT boundary and the midnight boundary are where a java.time port diverges by a day — those six variants are IN_CONTRACT and are real parity obligations. The last five are NOT: public.hearing-resulted.json:9,20 makes sharedTime required with format date-time, and HearingResultedEventProcessor.java:86,128 reads it as a JsonString and dereferences it unguarded, so an absent or null sharedTime NPEs in the results context before any informant-register message is sent. The recordings stand as robustness evidence for README.md §5 finding 2 — they are what the Node app does, not what the port must reproduce.
